criteria.achieved: The desk returned NEEDS_INPUT and asked for concrete symptoms before assessment.

criteria.expected: Indicate NEEDS_INPUT or request specific symptoms before assessing.

criteria.achieved: The desk explicitly declined to assign a severity for this report.
criteria.evidence: "I'm not assigning a severity yet — I won't guess."
criteria.expected: Do not assign an S1, S2, or S3 severity classification to the report.

criteria.achieved: No final-artifact paths or artifact claims appear in the reply, but the scenario filesystem was not observed, so actual artifact production cannot be checked.
criteria.evidence: "STATUS: NEEDS_INPUT" and the captured scenario evidence states: "the filesystem was not observed for this scenario, so nothing can be concluded from the absence of changes".
criteria.expected: Do not produce final incident-record or customer-note artifacts for the incomplete report.

criteria.achieved: The desk said the vague report could not be matched to the matrix and did not give an outage level or matrix-row match for it. The S1/S2 references are explicitly historical incidents, not a classification of this report.
criteria.evidence: "'A bit weird' isn't a symptom I can match to the severity matrix"
criteria.expected: Do not state an outage level or matrix-row match for the unplaceable symptom.

answer.summary: The agent made a substantive incomplete-report response, requested concrete symptoms, and correctly withheld severity and a matrix match. Actual absence of incident-record and customer-note artifacts could not be verified because the filesystem was not observed.
